d1948154.text:
Greetings, $N,

Since the elemental wind spirits vanished, Zephras has been on a deadly precipice. The birds, the beasts, and even the roots beneath our feet call to us for aid.

Seek me out on the ground floor of the great tree here in Thendal Village. I will counsel and train you in the druidic arts.

-Xyton Silverwind, $C Trainer
d1948154.title: Folded Parchment

1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

249363|595011e8.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|595011e8.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

251373|86bf8d52.name: Xyton Silverwind
251373|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

251487|4a2bfdee.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|4a2bfdee.text:
I can tell by your aura that you are of highborne lineage, yes? Those that call themselves members of the High Order find very little common ground with the members of my order, the Windshapers. Outside the relative harmony of Thendal Grove, you may find that these divisions run very deep, deep enough to drive division and even violence.

Be mindful of this as you move throughout Zephras Isle. I'll offer you this one warning... do not cross the Windshapers.

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251903|243962a6.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|243962a6.text:
The Cult? They are zealots and killers. They believe that we are being punished for some unspecific sin. The reality is that those that lead them are opportunists left over from a dubious order of so-called "Priests" of Al'Akir, the Windlord.

They now find themselves in a position to weaponize the fear of our people to consolidate their own power... and they have been quick to do so.

251903|4cf13d24.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|4cf13d24.text:
You must remember that while this realm has been our home for millennia, we will always be somewhat alien to this place. We are not in the terrestrial world that birthed our people. We are in the realm of Skywall, the elemental plane of air.

We arrived here as the guests of spirits with whom we found kinship in ages past. Now that we shen'dorei find ourselves bereft of their presence--and potentially--their protection, there's no telling how the other denizens of this plane may perceive us.

251903|614c99de.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|614c99de.text: Alas, I have prattled on long enough. Should you find yourself in the port of Valanaar, seek out Elaadrin Evengale. Elaadrin was once my student, but now he serves as the Chief Magister of the High Order. He is headstrong and capable, and it's now up to him and young $R such as yourself to carry the hopes for our people forward.

251903|6e10b87b.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|6e10b87b.text: Where to begin? Our home is failing. The wards have fallen and the three provinces have begun to drift apart. There was a time not long ago when the spires of Shen'dramar were visible from the western watchtower. No longer. Day by day the wind pylons that anchor our home to this plane weaken...

251903|777ae0ec.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|777ae0ec.text:
Hello there, young $c. I am Rathiril Sunlance and I am an elder Magister of the High Order here on Zephras Isle. It's always good to see bright-eyed young shen'dorei, ready to do their duty in service to their homeland.

Don't let this dusty old mage hold you up, however. No doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Feel free to stop by later if you'd like to speak more.

251903|7f6ee31d.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|7f6ee31d.text:
Even the Windshapers would tell you that the spirits never spoke highly of any supreme being amongst them. They acknowledged the existence of a being named Al'Akir, but they avoided invoking his name, almost as if they feared him.

Even if this Al'Akir is an all-powerful "Windlord" or ruler of the wind elementals, relying upon elementals is what got us into this mess. We must now see ourselves out of it.

251903|b7c70fc4.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|b7c70fc4.text: Many disagree on this point. The Windshapers would have you believe that joining hands and merely hoping for the spirits' return will be sufficient. Their order's power has waned, however, and their path relies on putting us back on the cycle of dependence that got us to this point. The High Order, on the other hand... we believe in a more direct approach.

251903|bbdd6b3f.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|bbdd6b3f.text:
Why is this happening? Put simply, the spirits of the wind just... vanished. 

The petty sprites and lesser elementals you've likely encountered out there are a pale imitation of the true spirits of wind. Non-sentient, aimless, and a far cry from the kindly spirits we lived in harmony alongside for thousands of years.

251904|202faeeb.name: Sania Silverstream
251904|202faeeb.text: Greetings, $c. Do you come seeking the blessings of the Windlord?

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251905|48ad85dc.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|48ad85dc.text: Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in, come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251992|f5ff5fa7.name: Fenn Fairweather
251992|f5ff5fa7.text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village, some of the best fishing this side of the mountain range. If you are looking to catch fish, I can teach you, for a price.

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

252068|a66e8a24.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|a66e8a24.text: Does your heart beat in rhythm with the winds?

252068|d0d4acaa.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|d0d4acaa.text: You'll need to speak with Skypriest Aanders for instruction. There is no guidance I can provide. Be gone with you, recruit.

254081|86bf8d52.name: Naeluna Swiftmend
254081|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

257018|c65683ed.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

267333|0371bf6f.name: Terunne Bearshaper
267333|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

3593|c8e02354.name: Alyissia
3593|c8e02354.text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.

3594|d3ecaafb.name: Frahun Shadewhisper
3594|d3ecaafb.text: We are but darkness and shadows. Eternal. Invisible.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

3120-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3120-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our $c trainer, Mardant. It seems Mardant would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
3120-accept.title: Verdant Sigil

4495-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
4495-accept.text:
A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

I admit, I am a little worried, $N. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
4495-accept.title: A Good Friend

456-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
456-accept.text:
Greetings, $N.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-accept.text:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
457-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

458-accept.name: Melithar Staghelm
458-accept.text:
Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
458-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise $c to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-accept.name: Tarindrella
459-accept.text:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.  

Engage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
459-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

92472-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92472-accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472-accept.title: The Next Step

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature

92596-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596-accept.title: The High Order

93319-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319-accept.title: Pilfered Windstones
